items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: Removing old desks from your home or office doesn’t need to be difficult. At Live Junk Free, we take care of everything for you. Just give us a call or send us a picture of the desk you want removed, and we’ll give you a fair price right away with no hidden charges. You can choose any time that works best for you – we even offer same-day service if you need quick removal.

When our team arrives, they will carefully take apart and remove your desk without damaging your space. We use special tools and protective coverings to keep your floors and walls safe. The best part is we don’t just throw desks in the trash. We work hard to recycle the materials or donate good-quality desks to schools and charities so they can be used again.

Most desk removals take less than one hour from start to finish. Our workers are fully trained and insured, so you don’t need to worry about anything. They will do all the heavy lifting, air dust afterwards, and make sure your space looks neat when they leave.

c: Watch the transformation happen right before your eyes. Our skilled team carefully removes every desk and office item, clearing your space completely, leaving you with a fresh, open area ready for new possibilities.

items.q: 1. Do you remove all types of desks?
a: Yes, we take away any desk, big, small, office, gaming, or standing. Even if it’s old or broken, we’ll handle it easily. Just tell us what you need.

items.q: 2. Can you disassemble my desk before removing it?
a: Yes, if your desk needs to be taken apart, we’ll do it safely. We handle the heavy stuff, so you just relax while we take care of everything.

items.q: 3. What areas do you serve for desk removal?
a: We work in Toronto, Markham, Mississauga, Richmond Hill, and nearby spots. Not sure? Just call us and we’ll check if we cover your area.

items.q: 4. How much does desk removal cost?
a: Prices change based on size and location, but we’ll tell you upfront, no surprises! Call for a free estimate so you know the cost first.

items.q: 5. Can you recycle or donate my desk?
a: Yes, if it’s in good shape, we donate it. If not, we recycle it. We hate waste and always try to help the planet.
